validationRepairs: The host Actor.kind is optional. The contract now accepts an absent kind, preserving its existing equality gate; an exact import guard retires the unused World concealment import. The first rejected type-check receipt is retained.
The metadata and captured-damage unit assertions first check that required events exist, preventing unrelated TypeErrors from masquerading as mutation detection.
Evade and block tests assert exact recent-event and buff-consumption values, closing the initially surviving event-stamp fault.
Installed fault selection uses the observable immune-fixture wounding flag. Borrowed continuation-result identity is tested independently without mutating the read-only original hit tap.
performanceAcceptance: Open. Initial ABBA timing was 16–35% higher; identical and reversed-order repeats varied substantially. All three series and diagnostic profiles are retained. These observations establish neither parity nor a stable regression, and do not measure total allocation volume or physical-device acceptance. The original host StatSheet.compute dominated both sampled profiles.
scope: Damage admission, ordered landing/refusal reactions, separate scalar captures and borrowed native result through pool feeding. Sustain, threat, world reactions, remaining hit aftermath/delivery/death, dedicated engine packages and physical-device optimization remain open.
